projects.title: Thero Studio
projects.shortDescription: Angular website toolkit where developers can customize, build and export their own all-in-one CSS file with all stylistic choices.
projects.longDescription: Angular website toolkit where developers can customize, build and export their own all-in-one CSS file with all stylistic choices. As well as being able to export a full starting file for react and angular, including your CSS file.
features: Exportable starting files for React and Angular

projects.title: Petit Moments
projects.shortDescription: Bachelor thesis app: pin personal memories to real-world locations.
projects.longDescription: Mobile app where users pin personal memories to real-world locations on a map, then connect moments across different users to collaboratively build shared stories.
features: Location-based memory pinning with interactive map
Cross-user story threading into a collective narrative

projects.title: AK Building Solutions
projects.shortDescription: AK Building Solutions is a Belgium based electric start-up.
projects.longDescription: AK Building Solutions is a Belgium based electric start-up, they needed me to create a sleek and modern website that allows them to attract more customers. In addition I created a typographic logo and worked together with them to find a good look and feel of their brand.
features: Contact function that sends e-mail automatically

projects.title: Jongeren Annasr
projects.shortDescription: End-to-end visual identity and content strategy for a Vilvoorde youth organisation.
projects.longDescription: End-to-end visual identity and content strategy for Jongeren Annasr, a Vilvoorde-based youth organisation. The brand was developed from the ground up and extended across print and digital touchpoints.
features: Full brand identity: logo, color system, typography
Tone of voice and messaging guidelines
Bilingual (NL/FR) social media content and event visuals
Consistent visual output across Instagram and community platforms

projects.title: Petit Moments — UX/UI
projects.shortDescription: Full UX/UI case for a location-based memory & storytelling app.
projects.longDescription: UX/UI design of Petit Moments — the mobile app from my bachelor thesis. The case covers user flows, information architecture, and high-fidelity interface design in Figma.
features: Memory card, map view, and story timeline UI
Design system ready for hand-off to development

projects.title: AK Building Solutions — Identity
projects.shortDescription: Typographic logo and brand look & feel for an electric start-up.
projects.longDescription: Typographic logo and brand identity for AK Building Solutions, a Belgium-based electric start-up. Worked directly with the founders to define the look and feel of the brand across digital touchpoints.
features: Applied to the company website and communication
